newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi's SCECO in $108 mln deal with KEC.
newsitem.headline: Saudi's SCECO in $108 mln deal with KEC.

text.p: Saudi Consolidated Electric Company - East (SCECO-East) on Tuesday awarded a 405 million riyal ($108 million) construction deal to Indian firm KEC International and the Saudi Al-Sharif Group for Trading & Contracting.
The companies will construct two 380 kilovolt transmission lines linking a new power plant, Ghazlan II, with a substation called Al-Fadhil in the eastern city of Dammam.

The contract was one of four deals worth 1.159 billion riyals ($309 million) awarded by SCECO-East to integrate its new power plant into the main generating system to keep pace with domestic demand. ($=3.75 riyals)
